name: LSM14A mRNA processing body assembly factor

function.text: LSM14A is the approved symbol for LSM14A mRNA processing body assembly factor. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in mRNA binding; mitotic spindle assembly; negative regulation of translation.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Esophageal carcinoma; Glioblastoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: LSM14A encodes LSM14A mRNA processing body assembly factor. Its functions include mRNA binding and mitotic spindle assembly.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LSM14A have been reported in glioblastoma, colorectal carcinoma, and esophageal carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
